A10.construction: all 14 standard basis vectors in atlas coordinates
A10.route: structural: 14 distinct unit vectors have rank 14 over any field, so no prime can be exceptional

G10.description: the span of the twelve graph generators I10_1..I10_12

D10.description: the seed closure of the generalized stress flow
D10.construction: fixed-point closure over Q from the recorded seed
D10.route: exact integer closure and fraction-free elimination, independently verified; lower bound by an explicit 11x11 minor, upper bound by three exact annihilating covectors; see docs/D10_Q10_EXACT_RATIONAL_PROOF.md

Q10.construction: exact projection; representatives checked independent modulo D10, spanning, and each one necessary

B10.description: the span of the published equation-(4.24) candidates
B10.construction: each candidate recovered by an exact linear solve against a design matrix MOD P; there is no rational solve, so the coefficients themselves are only known modularly
B10.upper_bound_route: B10 is a subspace of A10, which is 14-dimensional
B10.status: CERTIFIED AT THE TESTED PRIMES; NOT PROVED OVER Q
B10.what_would_close_it: a rational solve for the published candidates against the design matrix, which needs a rational evaluator for the atlas elements; the present evaluators are modular

intersection_B10_P10.identity: dim(B ∩ P) = dim B + dim P - dim(B + P)
intersection_B10_P10.status: CERTIFIED AT THE TESTED PRIMES; NOT PROVED OVER Q
intersection_B10_P10.why: the identity needs all three dimensions over Q, and dim_Q B10 is itself only bounded, so the intersection inherits the gap

bounds_over_Q.conclusion: no exact value follows; the modular value 1 is what is certified, at the tested primes

manuscript_consequence: A10, G10, P10 and D10 may be stated as exact characteristic-zero dimensions. B10 and B10 ∩ P10 must carry 'at the tested primes' wherever they appear.
